payload.title: nats_credential_env_read_outside_factory recognises only a literal `process.env.X`, `process.env['X']` or `.get('X')`, so destructuring of process.env, an aliased env object, a constant key and globalThis.process.env reads of NATS_AUTH_* are never reported
evidence: tools/aria-adapters/security-boundary-adapter.ts:755-772 (credentialEnvVarRead: an element or property access on the literal chain process.env with a string-literal key, or a call named get/getOrThrow with a string-literal first argument; nothing else)
tools/aria-adapters/security-boundary-adapter.ts:774-781 (isProcessEnv accepts only the syntactic chain `process` `.env`; an alias, a parameter or globalThis.process.env is not process.env to it)
tools/aria-adapters/security-boundary-adapter.nats.test.ts:136-165 (pinned read forms: bracket, dot, config.get; no destructuring, alias or constant-key form is pinned)
libs/backend-common/src/nats/nats-connection.factory.ts:207-209 (the factory itself reads the three variables with the bracket form the rule hard-wires)
payload.rule_violated: ADR-015 (cert-is-identity): a module other than the factory must not rebuild NATS credentials; CLAUDE.md Architectural Approach tier 3 (make it detectable). This rule is the only detector of the bypass outside the factory module.
payload.notes: A new service that writes `const { NATS_AUTH_TOKEN } = process.env;`, `const env = process.env; env['NATS_AUTH_USER']`, `const KEY = 'NATS_AUTH_PASS'; process.env[KEY]` or `globalThis.process.env['NATS_AUTH_TOKEN']` and puts the value on its own connect() options gets no finding, which is the exact defect the two gateway bridges have and that the rule was written to find. Reproduced by running the adapter's credentialEnvVarRead on each shape at the revision: the bracket, dot, optional-chain, template-literal and config.get forms are reported; destructuring (plain and renamed), alias, alias-dot, constant key, globalThis.process.env, an env parameter and the `in` operator are not. A repo-wide grep of non-spec code shows no such shape on main today, so the miss is reachable only by new code. Close condition: Extend the read detector to destructuring patterns whose initializer is process.env, to identifiers bound to process.env in the same module, to element keys that resolve to a string constant, and to globalThis/global.process.env, and add one near-miss and one finding variant per shape to security-boundary-adapter.nats.test.ts; the clean-main baseline stays at the two gateway bridges until they move onto the factory. Plan row: DET detector program (landing batch 1). Verified at head a47dc4d57c of open pull request #2134; the cited code is not on main until that pull request merges.
